summary: Iteration 15: Bidirectional role switching testing complete. All 18 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend role switching verified working for both Claire (guardian→beneficiary) and Robert (beneficiary→guardian). The switch-role API, activate-guardian, and get_effective_role helper function all work correctly. Tab bar labels configured based on effective role.

integration_issues.issue: Tab bar labels may not refresh immediately after role switch without page reload. The _layout.tsx correctly uses user.active_role || user.role, but expo-router Tabs component may cache. This is cosmetic - functionality works correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py get_effective_role(user) correctly returns user.active_role if set, otherwise user.role
auth_routes.py switch-role endpoint validates: beneficiary switch requires role==beneficiary OR has_beneficiary_space, guardian switch requires role==guardian OR has_guardian_space
All guardian_routes.py endpoints now use get_effective_role() instead of user['role'] for authorization
alert_routes.py GET /api/alerts filters by effective role, not DB role
Frontend index.tsx effectiveRole = user.active_role || user.role correctly determines dashboard display
Frontend _layout.tsx r = user.active_role || user.role correctly sets tab configuration
Frontend profile.tsx switch role calls refreshUser() after API call to update AuthContext

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All role switching flows working correctly
